chibi-direction-dwarf-brass-titan.subject: UNIT:DWARF:JUGGERNAUT
chibi-direction-dwarf-brass-titan.notes: A towering copper-and-soot-iron clockwork giant: domed iron head with glass eye lenses and no face, a copper chest with a furnace door and a gauge, iron arms and fists with an axe, two copper stacks with white steam, a copper clock key on its back and the green beacon. No brass despite the name.

chibi-direction-dwarf-city-1.subject: CITY:DWARF:1
chibi-direction-dwarf-city-1.notes: Level 1: a squat stone hold built into a rock outcrop, a round iron door, a copper roof, a chimney with steam and a dark iron pole for the pennant; ground removed, seated.

chibi-direction-dwarf-city-2.subject: CITY:DWARF:2
chibi-direction-dwarf-city-2.notes: Level 2: a stone tower cut into the hillside with a round iron gate and a copper cog, two copper-roofed houses inside a stone wall, steam, and the iron pole; ground removed, seated.

chibi-direction-dwarf-city-3.subject: CITY:DWARF:3
chibi-direction-dwarf-city-3.notes: Level 3: a fortress city against a grey peak: copper-domed towers, copper-roofed halls, chimneys with steam, a big copper cog wheel and the iron pole; ground removed, seated.

chibi-direction-dwarf-clockwork-gunner.subject: UNIT:DWARF:MARKSMAN
chibi-direction-dwarf-clockwork-gunner.notes: A round soot-iron automaton with a copper boiler belly, glass eye lenses and no face, a copper gatling arm, an iron claw, a big copper wind-up key on its back and the signal-green lamp as a beacon on its head (larger than the vehicles' 2-4 px dots: the constructs wear it as a beacon).

chibi-direction-dwarf-engineer.subject: UNIT:DWARF:CAPTAIN
chibi-direction-dwarf-engineer.notes: A short broad dwarf with a ginger-copper beard, goggles on a leather cap, a leather tool apron, a backpack boiler with a white steam stack, a big iron wrench over his shoulder and a copper cog: the unit to find and kill.

chibi-direction-dwarf-gyrocopter.subject: UNIT:DWARF:RAIDER
chibi-direction-dwarf-gyrocopter.notes: An open rotor craft: a goggled ginger-bearded pilot in a small soot-iron pod under a two-blade rotor, a copper engine with a steam stack, a tail and a bomb under the seat; no skids, so it flies with a gap under it; the signal-green lamp on the pod (the bomb also got a small green fuse light). Clearly not the Saucer's disc.

chibi-direction-dwarf-hammerer.subject: UNIT:DWARF:FIGHTER
chibi-direction-dwarf-hammerer.notes: A short broad dwarf with a ginger-copper beard, goggles on a round riveted iron helmet, a leather apron over an iron chest plate and a copper-banded war hammer; the helmet puffs are gone. Reviewed at 1:1, x4 and in the 32 px lineup.

chibi-direction-dwarf-mound.subject: UNIT:DWARF:MOUND
chibi-direction-dwarf-mound.notes: The mound: a low heap of dark earth and grey rocks with a grooved copper drill tip poking up and a white steam puff. Reads as a drill in the ground, not a flame.

chibi-direction-dwarf-mound-rider.subject: UNIT:DWARF:MOUND_RIDER
chibi-direction-dwarf-mound-rider.notes: The rider's mound: the same heap and drill with a soot-iron war hammer head sticking up beside it.

chibi-direction-dwarf-steam-cannon.subject: UNIT:DWARF:CATAPULT
chibi-direction-dwarf-steam-cannon.notes: A short fat iron barrel with copper bands on a closed copper carriage, a copper boiler with a stack and the signal-green lamp, two goggled ginger-bearded gunners. The carriage is copper rather than iron (the iron edit lost the barrel's bands and the rim); the black barrel and the crew tell it from the Rocket Cart.

chibi-direction-dwarf-steam-mole.subject: UNIT:DWARF:GUARD
chibi-direction-dwarf-steam-mole.notes: A squat riveted soot-iron tub on tracks with a big copper cone drill pointing forward, a stack with white steam, a ginger-bearded dwarf in the hatch and the signal-green lamp on its side. Small in its 56 x 80 canvas: squat and low, as the spec asks.

chibi-direction-dwarf-steam-tank.subject: UNIT:DWARF:KNIGHT
chibi-direction-dwarf-steam-tank.notes: A closed soot-iron dome with a copper band, light grey rim highlights, a cannon snout, a tall copper stack with white steam, a ginger-bearded dwarf in the hatch and the signal-green lamp on the dome.

chibi-direction-dwarf-whirligig.subject: UNIT:DWARF:SWORDSMAN
chibi-direction-dwarf-whirligig.notes: Bead pulp_wars-2yc.34: accepted Whirligig. A soot-black iron spinning top with a copper band on one wheel, exactly three square iron hammer heads on copper arms (two behind, one at the front centre), a copper wind-up key, two lenses, the signal-green lamp and a puff of steam on top; 70 x 84 px. Reviewed at 1:1 and x4 on Grass, Snow and Mountain beside the Clockwork Gunner and the Steam Tank.

chibi-direction-effect-dwarf-bomb-blast.subject: EFFECT:BOMB_BLAST
chibi-direction-effect-dwarf-bomb-blast.notes: The bomb blast: a dark iron bomb bursting with a copper-and-spark flash and a ring of steam.

chibi-direction-effect-dwarf-eruption.subject: EFFECT:ERUPTION
chibi-direction-effect-dwarf-eruption.notes: The eruption burst: a fan of earth clods and rocks thrown up from one point over a pale dust cone, mapped to the forge palette.

chibi-direction-effect-dwarf-repair-spar.subject: EFFECT:REPAIR_SPARKS
chibi-direction-effect-dwarf-repair-spar.notes: A star-shaped spray of pale spark streaks with two copper dots: the Repair sparks.

chibi-direction-effect-dwarf-steam-puff.subject: EFFECT:STEAM_PUFF
chibi-direction-effect-dwarf-steam-puff.notes: A round white steam puff of four lumps.

chibi-direction-icon-action-assemble.subject: ICON:ACTION:ASSEMBLE
chibi-direction-icon-action-assemble.notes: A copper wind-up key across an iron cog: Assemble.

chibi-direction-icon-action-bomb-run.subject: ICON:ACTION:BOMB_RUN
chibi-direction-icon-action-bomb-run.notes: A round black bomb with a copper cap under a small two-blade rotor, with motion lines: Bomb Run.

chibi-direction-icon-action-knockback.subject: ICON:ACTION:KNOCKBACK
chibi-direction-icon-action-knockback.notes: An iron cannon firing with a big steam puff and a white push arrow below: Knockback. Shows the gun rather than the push alone.

chibi-direction-icon-action-plated.subject: ICON:ACTION:PLATED
chibi-direction-icon-action-plated.notes: A thick riveted soot-iron plate with a copper band and a little steam: Plated.

chibi-direction-icon-action-repair.subject: ICON:ACTION:DWARF:TEND_WOUNDED
chibi-direction-icon-action-repair.notes: An iron wrench with sparks at its jaw: Repair.

chibi-direction-icon-action-tunnel.subject: ICON:ACTION:TUNNEL
chibi-direction-icon-action-tunnel.notes: A copper drill with dark spiral grooves boring into a heap of earth with clods flying: Tunnel. Redrawn from the Bomb Run icon by an edit (no faction layer).

chibi-direction-icon-status-clockwork.subject: ICON:STATUS:CLOCKWORK
chibi-direction-icon-status-clockwork.notes: A copper cog wheel with iron details: the Clockwork glyph.

chibi-direction-icon-status-dug-in.subject: ICON:STATUS:DUG_IN
chibi-direction-icon-status-dug-in.notes: A ring of piled earth and sandbags, empty in the middle (a few copper bits on its far rim): the dug-in status glyph.

chibi-direction-icon-tech-blasting-charg.subject: ICON:TECH:DWARF:EXPLOSIVES
chibi-direction-icon-tech-blasting-charg.notes: A fat copper-cased charge with iron bands, a drill tip and a fuse with steam: Blasting Charges, not a Goblin firework.

chibi-direction-icon-tech-dig-in.subject: ICON:TECH:DWARF:FORTIFICATION
chibi-direction-icon-tech-dig-in.notes: An iron shovel stuck in a low mound of earth: Dig In (Fortification). Small in the square.

chibi-direction-portrait-dwarf-brass-tit.subject: PORTRAIT:DWARF:JUGGERNAUT
chibi-direction-portrait-dwarf-brass-tit.notes: Bust of the clockwork giant: a domed iron head with two big lenses, the green beacon on top, iron shoulders and a copper chest with a furnace door; no face.

chibi-direction-portrait-dwarf-clockwork.subject: PORTRAIT:DWARF:MARKSMAN
chibi-direction-portrait-dwarf-clockwork.notes: Bust of a machine: a domed iron head with a flat riveted face plate and two lenses, no face, the green lamp on top, a copper key and a boiler chest.

chibi-direction-portrait-dwarf-engineer.subject: PORTRAIT:DWARF:CAPTAIN
chibi-direction-portrait-dwarf-engineer.notes: Bust: goggles on a leather cap, a huge ginger-copper beard, the boiler stack with steam and the wrench on his shoulder.

chibi-direction-portrait-dwarf-gyrocopte.subject: PORTRAIT:DWARF:RAIDER
chibi-direction-portrait-dwarf-gyrocopte.notes: The whole gyrocopter: rotor, goggled ginger-bearded pilot in an iron pod, copper engine with steam, bomb and lamp. Busy at 48 px but every part reads.

chibi-direction-portrait-dwarf-hammerer.subject: PORTRAIT:DWARF:FIGHTER
chibi-direction-portrait-dwarf-hammerer.notes: Bust: round riveted iron helmet with goggles, a huge ginger-copper beard, iron shoulder plates and the hammer head beside him; helmet puffs removed as on the map sprite.

chibi-direction-portrait-dwarf-steam-can.subject: PORTRAIT:DWARF:CATAPULT
chibi-direction-portrait-dwarf-steam-can.notes: The whole Steam Cannon: a fat barrel on a dark iron carriage, a ginger-bearded gunner, a copper boiler with steam and the green lamp.

chibi-direction-portrait-dwarf-steam-mol.subject: PORTRAIT:DWARF:GUARD
chibi-direction-portrait-dwarf-steam-mol.notes: The whole Steam Mole: iron tub, a big copper cone drill, a dwarf in the hatch, steam and the green lamp.

chibi-direction-portrait-dwarf-steam-tan.subject: PORTRAIT:DWARF:KNIGHT
chibi-direction-portrait-dwarf-steam-tan.notes: The whole Steam Tank: a black iron dome with a cannon snout, a tall stack with steam, a dwarf in the hatch and the green lamp; small in the square.

chibi-direction-portrait-dwarf-whirligig.subject: PORTRAIT:DWARF:SWORDSMAN
chibi-direction-portrait-dwarf-whirligig.notes: Bead pulp_wars-2yc.34, correction pass: accepted Whirligig portrait.
